title: ClickHouse Cloud access
description: The artifact epack-collector-clickhouse emits at artifacts/clickhouse.json: who can reach a ClickHouse Cloud organization through its console and API, and each configured service's database access settings. A value the collector could not read is null or absent, and the collector result records a gap for it. The collector checks its output against this schema when it emits.

collected_at_level.description: The collection level the artifact was made at. audit adds the inventories to trust's counts, and internal adds nothing more.

organization.description: The organization the API key belongs to.

created_at.description: When the organization was created. Null when the API does not say.

sso_enabled.description: Whether members sign in with SAML SSO. Always null, with a gap: ClickHouse Cloud has no API that reports it.

members.description: The organization's members. The Cloud API lists them only for a key with control-plane:organization:manage. Without it, or when the list fails, they are left out with a gap.

admin_count.description: Members who hold the Admin role.

mfa_enabled_count.description: Members who sign in with MFA. Always null, with a gap: ClickHouse Cloud has no API that reports it.

roles.description: The console roles assigned to the member.

admin.description: Whether the member holds the Admin role.

joined_at.description: When the member joined the organization. Null when the API does not say.

invitations.description: Invitations to join the organization that have not been accepted. Left out, with a gap, when they could not be listed.

total_count.description: Invitations that have not been accepted.

pending_count.description: Invitations that have not been accepted and have not expired.

expired_count.description: Invitations that expired before anyone accepted them.

email.description: The address the invitation was sent to.

roles.description: The console roles the invitation assigns.

created_at.description: When the invitation was sent. Null when the API does not say.

expired.description: Whether the invitation had expired when the collector ran.

api_keys.description: The organization's API keys. Left out, with a gap, when they could not be listed.

admin_count.description: API keys that hold the Admin role, enabled or not.

never_expires_count.description: API keys with no expiry date, enabled or not.

any_address_count.description: API keys whose IP access list admits any address, enabled or not.

never_used_count.description: API keys that have never been used, enabled or not.

inventory.description: Every API key, sorted by name.

roles.description: The console roles assigned to the key.

admin.description: Whether the key holds the Admin role.

created_at.description: When the key was created. Null when the API does not say.

expires_at.description: When the key expires. Null when it never expires.

never_expires.description: Whether the key has no expiry date.

ip_access_list.description: The addresses and ranges the key may be used from. 0.0.0.0/0 admits any address.

any_address.description: Whether the key's IP access list holds 0.0.0.0/0.

last_used_at.description: When the key was last used, to the minute. Null when it has never been used.

never_used.description: Whether the key has never been used.

console_roles.description: The organization's console roles and what each one grants. The Cloud API lists them only for a key with control-plane:organization:manage. Without it they are left out with a permission_denied gap.

inventory.description: Every console role, sorted by name.

api_key_count.description: API keys that hold the role.

policies.description: What the role allows or denies.

permissions.description: The permissions the policy allows or denies, such as control-plane:organization:view.

resources.description: What the permissions apply to, such as organization/<id> or instance/*.

services.description: One entry for each service the configuration lists, in its order. An empty list means the configuration lists no services, not that the organization has none.

name.description: The role's name, such as Admin or a custom role's name.

type.description: system for a role ClickHouse Cloud defines, custom for one the organization made.

storage.description: Where the server keeps the user, such as replicated or users_xml.

auth_methods.description: Each way the user can sign in. Any one of them is enough.

type.description: The sign-in method, as system.users names it, such as sha256_password, ssh_key, or no_password.

valid_until.description: When the method stops working, in UTC. Null when it never expires.

second_factor.description: The second factor the method also asks for, such as one_time_password. Null when it asks for none.

no_password.description: Whether one of the user's sign-in methods is no_password, so anyone who reaches the service can sign in as the user.

plaintext_password.description: Whether one of the user's sign-in methods keeps its password in plain text.

host_ip.description: The addresses and ranges the user may connect from. ::/0 means any address.

host_names.description: The host names the user may connect from.

host_names_regexp.description: Regular expressions for the host names the user may connect from.

host_names_like.description: LIKE patterns for the host names the user may connect from.

any_host.description: Whether the user may connect from any address.

storage.description: Where the server keeps the role.

user_name.description: The user the role is granted to. Null when it is granted to a role.

role_name.description: The role the role is granted to. Null when it is granted to a user.

granted_role_is_default.description: Whether the role is active when the grantee signs in.

with_admin_option.description: Whether the grantee may grant the role to others.

user_name.description: The user the privilege is granted to. Null when it is granted to a role.

role_name.description: The role the privilege is granted to. Null when it is granted to a user.

access_type.description: The privilege, such as SELECT or CREATE USER.

database.description: The database it applies to. Null for every database.

table.description: The table it applies to. Null for every table.

column.description: The column it applies to. Null for every column.

is_partial_revoke.description: Whether the row revokes part of a broader grant.

grant_option.description: Whether the grantee may grant the privilege to others.

storage.description: Where the server keeps the profile.

apply_to_all.description: Whether it applies to every user and role, apart from those in apply_to_except.

apply_to_list.description: The users and roles it applies to, when apply_to_all is false.

apply_to_except.description: The users and roles it does not apply to, when apply_to_all is true.

profile_name.description: The profile the element belongs to, or null.

user_name.description: The user the element is set on, or null.

role_name.description: The role the element is set on, or null.

setting_name.description: The setting, such as readonly. Null when the element only inherits a profile.

value.description: The setting's value, or null when the element sets none.

min.description: The lowest value the setting may be changed to, or null.

max.description: The highest value the setting may be changed to, or null.

writability.description: WRITABLE, CONST, or CHANGEABLE_IN_READONLY, or null when the element sets no constraint.

inherit_profile.description: The profile the element inherits, or null.

storage.description: Where the server keeps the quota.

keys.description: What usage is counted by, such as user_name. Empty when it is counted for everyone together.

durations.description: The length of each interval, in seconds.

apply_to_all.description: Whether it applies to every user and role, apart from those in apply_to_except.

apply_to_list.description: The users and roles it applies to, when apply_to_all is false.

apply_to_except.description: The users and roles it does not apply to, when apply_to_all is true.

is_randomized_interval.description: Whether the interval starts at a random offset.

limits.description: The limits that are set, keyed by their name in system.quota_limits without max_, such as queries or failed_sequential_authentications.

name.description: The policy's full name, such as tenant_a ON app.events.

database.description: The database the policy applies to.

table.description: The table the policy applies to, or empty for the whole database.

storage.description: Where the server keeps the policy.

is_restrictive.description: Whether the policy is restrictive rather than permissive.

apply_to_all.description: Whether it applies to every user and role, apart from those in apply_to_except.

apply_to_list.description: The users and roles it applies to, when apply_to_all is false.

apply_to_except.description: The users and roles it does not apply to, when apply_to_all is true.

host.description: The service's host, as the configuration names it.

user.description: The database user the collector read the service as.

users.description: The service's database users, from system.users.

customer_count.description: The customer's database users: every user apart from ClickHouse Cloud's own.

cloud_managed_count.description: ClickHouse Cloud's own database users, the ones stored in users_xml.

no_password_count.description: The customer's users who can sign in with no password.

plaintext_password_count.description: The customer's users with a password kept in plain text.

any_host_count.description: The customer's users who may connect from any address.

inventory.description: The customer's database users, sorted by name, with the default and sql-console users ClickHouse Cloud creates.

cloud_managed.description: ClickHouse Cloud's own database users, sorted by name.

roles.description: The service's database roles, from system.roles.

cloud_managed_count.description: The roles ClickHouse Cloud creates in every service: clickpipes_system, default_role, sql_console_admin, and sql_console_read_only.

inventory.description: The customer's database roles, sorted by name.

cloud_managed.description: The roles ClickHouse Cloud creates, sorted by name.

role_grants.description: The roles granted to users and roles, from system.role_grants. A grant to ClickHouse Cloud's own user or role is in cloud_managed.

with_admin_option_count.description: Role grants to the customer's users and roles that let the grantee grant the role to others.

inventory.description: The roles granted to the customer's users and roles.

cloud_managed.description: The roles granted to ClickHouse Cloud's own users and roles.

grants.description: The privileges granted to users and roles, from system.grants. A grant to ClickHouse Cloud's own user or role is in cloud_managed.

grant_option_count.description: Grants to the customer's users and roles that let the grantee grant the privilege to others.

inventory.description: The privileges of the customer's users and roles, and each part of one revoked again.

cloud_managed.description: The privileges of ClickHouse Cloud's own users and roles.

inventory.description: The customer's settings profiles, sorted by name.

cloud_managed.description: ClickHouse Cloud's own settings profiles, the ones stored in users_xml, sorted by name.

settings_profile_elements.description: What each settings profile, user, and role sets, from system.settings_profile_elements. An element of ClickHouse Cloud's own profile, user, or role is in cloud_managed.

cloud_managed_count.description: ClickHouse Cloud's own settings profile elements.

inventory.description: What the customer's profiles, users, and roles set. Each element belongs to one profile, user, or role.

cloud_managed.description: What ClickHouse Cloud's own profiles, users, and roles set.

inventory.description: The customer's quotas, sorted by name.

cloud_managed.description: ClickHouse Cloud's own quotas, the ones stored in users_xml, sorted by name.

quota_limits.description: The limit each quota sets for each interval, from system.quota_limits. A limit of ClickHouse Cloud's own quota is in cloud_managed.

inventory.description: The limits of the customer's quotas, for each interval.

cloud_managed.description: The limits of ClickHouse Cloud's own quotas, for each interval.

inventory.description: The customer's row policies, sorted by name, without their filter expressions, which can hold the customer's data.

cloud_managed.description: ClickHouse Cloud's own row policies, the ones stored in users_xml.
